Among Terminal 0.1.2-rc.1 is an internal acceptance candidate for desktop branding
and integration corrections, not an approved stable publication.

- Use the owner-approved square Among mark without changing the installed icon ID.
- Match AppImageLauncher-launched Wayland windows to their generated desktop entry,
  preserving the global GApplication identity and single-instance behaviour.
- Supply an existing public UI screenshot and a documentation link in AppStream
  metadata. A valid metainfo file does not guarantee an enriched standalone-DEB
  card in GNOME Software.

Native-DEB pin/coexistence, AppImageLauncher upgrade/reintegration and actual
GNOME Software views still need acceptance against this candidate's exact bytes.
No APT repository or signing key is added. Published 0.1.1 assets remain unchanged.
